app.subtitle: Hindsight replays your deposits and withdrawals into one asset at a time: every deposit buys it, every withdrawal sells some of it, and the position can never go negative. This is a Public Market Equivalent (PME) in the Long–Nickels sense (index comparison method), applied to your own portfolio.
app.realUnavailable: No inflation data, so no real figures.
app.title: Hindsight
app.scopeBlocked: These selected accounts cannot be analysed: {{names}}. Deselect them to continue.

table.realNote: Real figures use purchasing power at the end of the period: only gain, MWR and the difference change. The end value stays the same.

chart.logUnavailable: Logarithmic view requires positive values on every line, including “Net deposited”.

assumptions.item1: Before taxes and fees: the alternatives pay none; your portfolio includes those actually paid.
assumptions.item2: A deposit buys at the adjusted closing price (Yahoo Finance) of its day or the next trading day, a withdrawal sells that amount. Distributions are reinvested.
assumptions.item3: A withdrawal larger than the alternative's value only counts as far as it was covered.
assumptions.item4: Before an asset's first price the money stays uninvested and is bought at once on that day.
assumptions.item5: Only money flowing in from outside counts, not transfers between the selected accounts.
assumptions.item6: Asset transfers from outside count at the booking's price, else at the Wealthfolio price around that day. Worthless ones (e.g. spam tokens) are ignored.
assumptions.item7: Real: purchasing power at the end of the period, by the OECD consumer price index of your time zone's country (else your base currency's).
assumptions.item8: A period starting after your first deposit begins with your portfolio's value that day as a deposit.
assumptions.item9: The chart shows the gain so far: value minus the money each line itself took in and paid out up to that day, so deposits and withdrawals cause no jumps. “Difference” shows each line's gain minus your portfolio's on that day (your portfolio is the zero line; today's point is the gain difference). “Value” shows the value instead.
assumptions.item10: Max drawdown is time-weighted, so deposits and withdrawals count as neither gain nor loss: for an alternative on its price, for your portfolio on Wealthfolio's daily valuations.
assumptions.item11: A mix splits each deposit by its weights and sells pro rata; “Yearly” resets the weights on the first day of the year on which every asset has a price. Its drawdown is the strategy's (one unit invested at the start), not the simulated position's.

shortfall.title: Uncovered withdrawal
shortfall.p1: This alternative was worth less than a withdrawal; only the covered part counts. Compare the gain, not the end value.

lateStart.title: Late start
lateStart.p1: No prices before this date. The money stays uninvested until then and is bought at once.
lateStart.partial: A component has no prices before this date. Its share of every deposit stays uninvested until then and is bought at once; the rest of the mix is invested as usual.

info.mwrPeriod: Money-weighted return over the period (XIRR), not annualised.
info.depositsWindow: Includes {{value}}, your portfolio's value at the start of the period.
info.bookings: The count is original bookings in the period, excluding the opening value. Amounts are netted per day; alternatives only include covered withdrawals.
info.vs: This alternative's gain minus your portfolio's gain, with the same deposits and withdrawals on the same days. It equals the difference in end value unless the alternative could not fully cover a withdrawal: then it is lower by the uncovered amount (in real figures, that amount at end-of-period purchasing power).
info.maxDrawdown: Largest fall from a previous high, time-weighted: deposits and withdrawals are neither gains nor losses. For an alternative it is the asset's own price fall in your base currency, whatever the simulation held; for your portfolio the fall of what you actually held, from Wealthfolio's daily valuations. Nominal in both views.
info.recovery: Time from that high until it was reached again; while not recovered, the time since the high until the end of the period.
info.ddUnavailable: Your portfolio's drawdown needs a valuation of every selected account on each booking day; Wealthfolio's history has a gap there.

mix.title: Create a mix
mix.description: Each deposit is split by the weights, each withdrawal sells all assets pro rata. Yearly rebalancing resets the weights on the first trading day of each year.
mix.name: Name
mix.hintAssets: Choose an asset for every row.
mix.hintSum: The weights add up to {{sum}} %, not 100 %.
mix.hintInvalid: Every weight must be above 0 with at most two decimals, and every asset different.
mix.hintDuplicate: This mix is already in the list.
